svg.title: ECHO leaves building 1011267786, 4 November 2026
svg.desc: Two plan views drawn from the deployed fly's recorded positions. Left: inside the building after the physics repair, then the recorded exit at tick 7,664,060. Right: the rest of the recorded day, to its first meal at 19:27 UTC.
svg.text: The repaired physics let ECHO out of building 1011267786 · 4 November 2026

g.text: B · The day, to the first meal at 19:27 UTC
inside the building, before the recorded exit

svg.text: Recorded positions of the deployed fly (simulated, city frame, north up). Lines join one sample a simulated minute (dots and squares: about every 5 s);
they are not the path flown. No positions were recorded from 12:19 to 14:30 UTC. Sources: docs/benchmarks/echo-collision/2026-11-04/live/,
src/bethesda/model.ts, and the exit record in checkpoint 2563 (docs/ECHO_COLLISION.md). Generated by scripts/echo-exit-figure.ts.
